Description: Grass inclines left and right, always, at random slow speeds every time it completes a few right and left cycles. Smooth, not in whole pixel steps.
When units stay in the same position without moving, their image stretches down and up smoothly and softly, to indicate they're breathing.
When units move, it is little hops, and in these hops their image is stretched a little bit. The shadow stays on the ground during the jump.
When units talk they stretch up and down a little more abruptly than breathing. Eating uses the same animation.
When units sleep they drop to the ground horizontal, and the stretch breathing goes from side to side.
When units are enjoying a spectacle, they jump.
A fainted unit lies on the ground (like sleeping, but pale).
Trees sway a little in the wind, like the grass: the top leans left and right smoothly, each tree at its own slow speed.
When units pass behind a tree, that tree changes to 50% opacity smoothly.
A tombstone disappears softly after one day.

Below every unit, tree and structure there's a desaturated purple shadow (multiply) cast away from the sun: it points west in the morning, is short at noon and points east in the evening. It never turns when the unit turns, and it stays on the ground when they jump.
